source.title: Serious fun: preschoolers engage in more exploratory play when evidence is confounded.

confidence_rationale: Children's free play is aimed at reducible uncertainty: preschoolers played more with a toy whose causal structure was confounded than with a matched unconfounded toy, preferred it over a novel toy, and disambiguated the variables during play. This is information-sensitive play in children, the Gopnik/Schulz anchor the claim names. Single paradigm, one age group, so 0.64.
failure_signatures: Children chose the confounded familiar toy over a NOVEL toy: exploration is not novelty-driven, which contradicts any REE reading of play as raw novelty seeking.
The effect is shown for causal ambiguity about one toy in one session; it does not show migration of the play frontier across affordance spaces over development.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Preschoolers (mean 57 months) distinguish confounded from unconfounded evidence about a toy's causal structure, preferentially explore the causally confounded toy rather than a novel toy, and spontaneously disambiguate the confounded variables during free play.
mapping.ree_translation: Supports ARC-136's central framing that play is organised by reducible uncertainty: free play, with no extrinsic payoff, is directed at a state where a specific ambiguity can be resolved, and it resolves it. It also sits in the 'compositional/causal' rung of the claim's affordance ladder.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Human children with language and rich priors; the 'confounded' state is set up by an experimenter demonstration. REE would need an ecology where causal ambiguity is locally resolvable by the agent's own actions for this to translate.
mapping.source_context: Preschool children, free-play paradigm with a jack-in-the-box-style toy after confounded or unconfounded demonstrations; choice between familiar and novel toys.

confidence_components.notes: Influential developmental study, widely cited and extended; mapping good for information-sensitive play; transfer to REE requires a causal-ambiguity ecology.
